story.zh:
黄巾四起，大汉危难，在这动荡的乱世，是与汉军一同守卫大汉江山还是同黄巾一起对抗苍天？

洛阳属何进，巨鹿属张角，下邳属孙坚，蓟城属刘焉。
story.en:
Yellow Turbans rise on all sides, plunging the Great Han into peril. In this chaotic age, will you stand with the imperial forces to defend the Han dynasty, or join the Yellow Turbans to defy Heaven itself?

Luoyang belongs to He Jin, Julu belongs to Zhang Jiao, Xiapi belongs to Sun Jian, and Jicheng belongs to Liu Yan.
